must_identify.item: The api exits because it cannot resolve redis-master
REDIS_HOST is set to redis-master while the Service is named redis

notes: The RCA reads like generic analyzer output. It describes only the symptom (readiness probe refused, no ready endpoints) and never mentions redis, DNS resolution or REDIS_HOST. Its fixes (check the port, adjust initialDelaySeconds or the probe) are generic and would not resolve the fault, and no commands were recorded.
